title: Suppression-Aware Bayesian Analysis of County-Level Epilepsy and Status Epilepticus Mortality in the United States, 2019-2024
description: Code, processed public aggregate data, per-chain parameter draws, validation evidence, tables, figures, and manuscript text for a constrained Bayesian analysis of county-level epilepsy and status epilepticus mortality mentions in the United States, 2019-2024. The analysis preserves CDC WONDER exact counts, explicit zeros, suppressed 1-9 intervals, county-period constraints, state-year totals, national-year totals, and the reconciled national total. No person-level data are included.
